pageTitle: Texas Lottery Results and Winning Numbers

items.question: How do you purchase lottery tickets in Texas?
items.answer:
If you’re over the age of 18, you can buy lottery tickets at licensed retailers. This is the only legal option in Texas since online purchases and sales by phone and mail aren’t allowed.

 

Additionally, you can buy tickets in advance for every lottery game. Cash Five allows up to 12 advanced draws, while Lotto Texas, Texas Two Step, Powerball, and Mega Millions offer ten advanced draws. You can purchase a maximum of 24 advanced draws for the remaining lottery games.

items.question: What lottery games can you play in Texas?
items.answer:
There are various lottery games you can play in Texas. Furthermore, many of these games occur several times a day, which means you have multiple chances of winning. In total, there are 17 different draws in eight different games, each with their own Texas Lottery numbers:

 

Pick 3 Morning, Day, Evening, Night - Choose three numbers between 0-9

Daily 4 Morning, Day, Evening, Night - Choose four numbers between 0-9

All or Nothing Morning, Day, Evening, Night - Choose 12 numbers between 1-24

Cash Five - Choose five numbers between 1-35

Lotto Texas - Choose six numbers between 1-54

Texas Two Step - Choose four numbers between 1-35 along with an additional number

Texas Lottery Powerball - Choose five numbers between 1-69 and another number between 1-26

Texas Lottery Mega Millions - Choose five numbers between 1-70 and an extra number between 1-25

All games offer a top prize, while Lotto Texas, Texas Two Step, Powerball, and Mega Millions have a jackpot up for grabs. Furthermore, take note that you can’t play the Texas Lottery Lucky for Life game.

items.question: Where and how do you claim winnings from the Texas Lottery?
items.answer:
If you win a prize worth $599 or less, you can claim it at your local retailer or visit one of the Texas Lottery Claim Centers. Additionally, you can choose to post your signed ticket via registered mail to the Texas State Lottery.

 

Prizes worth $600 or more can be claimed at any of the Texas Lottery Claim Centers. Alternatively, you can complete a claim form and mail it to the Texas Lottery. Remember to sign the back of your ticket and post it as well.

 

You can claim any prize over $2.5 million at the Texas Lottery Commission in Austin. You’ll need to make an appointment and visit the center in person.

 

If you submit your claim via post, you can expect to wait between four to six weeks to receive your winnings. Additionally, you must claim any winning tickets within 180 days.

items.question: How do you play and win in the Texas Lottery?
items.answer:
To win in the Texas Lottery, you need to select the same numbers picked in the draw. For instance, Lotto Texas incorporates numbers 1-54, and its rules state that you must choose six numbers within this range.

 

If you correctly predict all six of the Texas Lottery winning numbers, you’ll win the grand jackpot. However, you can still win some cash if you manage to match a minimum of two numbers.

items.question: What’s the biggest Texas Lottery win?
items.answer: Although there have been many Texas Lottery winners, the largest payout occurred in October 2019, when a Leander resident won $227 million in the Mega Millions jackpot. The winner went with the cash option and received $157,091,592 in a single lump sum.

items.question: When is the Texas Lottery results draw?
items.answer:
The results of the Texas Lottery games take place as follows:

 

Pick 3 Morning, Daily 4 Morning, All or Nothing Morning draws take place Monday to Saturday at 10:00 am

Pick 3 Day, Daily 4 Day, All or Nothing Day draws take place Monday to Saturday at 12:27 pm

Pick 3 Evening, Daily 4 Evening, All or Nothing Evening draws take place Monday to Saturday at 6:00 pm

Pick 3 Night, Daily 4 Night, and All or Nothing Night draws take place Monday to Saturday at 10:12 pm

Cash Five draws take place Monday to Saturday at 10:12 pm

Lotto Texas draws take place Wednesday and Saturday at 10:12 pm

Texas Two Step draws take place Monday and Thursday at 10:12 pm

Powerball draws take place Wednesday and Saturday at 10:12 pm

Mega Millions draws take place Tuesday and Friday at 10:12 pm

items.question: What is the Texas Lottery second chance?
items.answer:
You can download the Texas Lottery app and get access to a variety of features. These include more winning opportunities, viewing results, locating authorized retailers, and finding your favorite Texas Lottery scratch tickets, to name a few.

 

Additionally, you can access Texas Lottery codes and enter second-chance drawings on non-winning picks by using the Texas Lottery ticket scanner within the app.

items.question: Do I have to pay tax on Texas Lottery winnings?
items.answer:
Yes. If you’re a US citizen or a Texas resident, any prize over $5,000 attracts the following taxes:

 

State tax: 0%

 

Federal tax: 24%

 

Total: 24%
